Bazel 9.3.0-dzbarsky51

- Preserve executable bits when restoring remote repository caches, including files prefetched during injection. Invalidate marker files created before the fix. (bazelbuild/bazel#31729)
- Reuse Starlark attribute transitions by configured mapper identity, with an eagerly initialized weak-key cache and correct AutoCodec restoration. (bazelbuild/bazel#31732)
- Stream current-version lockfiles and Starlark repository attributes and facts, reducing parsing allocations. Preserve the existing behavior for edited and older lockfiles. (bazelbuild/bazel#31766)
- Share discovered-input Skyframe dependencies and preserve rewinding of lost inputs. (bazelbuild/bazel#31767)
- Reduce allocations in Merkle tree construction and Starlark format fields; retain the file digest cache across non-build commands and bound remote output-checker history.
- Avoid rebuilding for unchanged remote symlinks; verify raw symlink targets and recorded repository inputs before reusing cached state. Accept trailing-dot cached repository names.
- Speed up Starlark list/tuple iteration and memoize immutable-list hashing. Defer profiler lane allocation until a task will be recorded and clean up profilers after early command failures.
